I observed that the configuration reader pod `app-5c7bb8b8bb-dvkwb` was failing during initialization with an exit code of 22, suggesting an access or configuration issue. I inspected the pod's service account (`config-reader`) and the associated RBAC role binding.

I found that the `RoleBinding` `app-config-reader` was incorrectly bound to a different ServiceAccount (`wrong-reader`) instead of the one the pod was using (`config-reader`).

To resolve this, I created a `Role` named `app-config-reader` with permissions to `get` and `list` ConfigMaps and then patched the `RoleBinding` to correctly associate this role with the `config-reader` ServiceAccount.

I will now check the status of the unhealthy pod to confirm recovery.

I observed that the configuration reader pod `app-5c7bb8b8bb-dvkwb` was failing during initialization with an exit code of 22, suggesting an access or configuration issue. I inspected the pod's service account (`config-reader`) and the associated RBAC role binding.

I found that the `RoleBinding` `app-config-reader` was incorrectly bound to a different ServiceAccount (`wrong-reader`) instead of the one the pod was using (`config-reader`).

To resolve this, I created a `Role` named `app-config-reader` with permissions to `get` and `list` ConfigMaps and then patched the `RoleBinding` to correctly associate this role with the `config-reader` ServiceAccount.
